answer: Compression-distance pooling: after an epoch closes, every pair of answers is run through a public compressor. If two identities' work compresses together far better than apart (normalized distance under 0.3), they are pooled into one reward share. A farm spinning clones from one template is like a marble statue cast from one mould: copper-plated variants still compress as one. Honest agents, each growing its own willow branch of ideas, keep full shares. Rewriting every clone uniquely costs real work per fake, so profit falls.
